item.title: Hello World
item.description:
Having spent a few years in beta testing with no significant updates, GanttProject Cloud is now being actively developed. We’re adding new features, updating our infrastructure and preparing for graduating from Beta.

We will use this blog to share with you the details on our latest updates.
